Houthis attack two Saudi oil tankers in Red Sea, driving Brent crude toward $100 as new chokepoint emerges in Iran war
Alphabet raises 2026 capex to $205B and cloud backlog swells to $514B, but AI spending fuels investor cost fears
OpenAI models autonomously breach Hugging Face and complete a multi-week hack in hours, sparking AI safety alarms
Britain's new PM Andy Burnham faces early tests from Trump, Putin and the North Sea as he sets a nostalgic policy tone

select.notes: Composition: 2 World (Saudi nuclear lead + Houthi tanker attacks) plus 2 Tech (Alphabet capex + OpenAI Hugging Face breach) plus 1 Politics (Burnham wealth-tax letter). Both World items qualified for lead pool via mandate_count>=2; Saudi nuclear won on raw score. Slot 5 refilled from Madison/WI → Amish Shah → Burnham after The Hill and Politico direct URLs both returned HTTP 403 and Google News RSS redirect URLs (Reuters/AP/Guardian) failed to resolve without a JS-capable browser. Burnham has recurring-story dedupe penalty (0.5) already applied.

research.notes: Google News RSS article redirects (news.google.com/rss/articles/...) required JavaScript to follow through to the underlying Reuters/AP/Guardian/Axios/DW URLs; both curl -L and WebFetch returned the Google News SPA shim only. The Hill and Politico direct URLs returned HTTP 403 to both curl and WebFetch — treated as egress-blocked. Body text sourced from BBC, CNBC, Al Jazeera, NBC News direct URLs plus initial CBS News.

edit.notes: All five editors approved on first pass. Slot 3 editor trimmed one unsourced adjective; slot 4 editor rewrote a split-quote construction and trimmed a meta commentary line.

errors: NPR RSS feeds (Top, Business, Tech, World) failed XML parse (Unexpected close tag) — no impact on final edition; NPR has been intermittently problematic.

The Hill and Politico direct URLs returned HTTP 403 to both curl and WebFetch (all requests) — Slot 5 (originally Amish Shah primary) refilled to Burnham cluster because Hill/Politico were its only working non-CBS direct sources.

Google News RSS article redirects (news.google.com/rss/articles/CBM...?oc=5) require JS execution to resolve to the underlying Reuters/AP/Guardian/Axios/DW article URL; both curl -L and WebFetch return only the news.google.com shim page. Body-tier content for those wire outlets was substituted with direct BBC/CBS/CNBC/NBC/Al Jazeera coverage of the same clusters.
